salvageable_components.item_name: interior window sill and frame assembly

technical_features.labels_or_markings: No visible manufacturer labels or certification badges; surface shows minor paint chipping and dirt accumulation.
technical_features.connection_type: dry-bolted or snap-fit to structural frame

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove by detaching from structural frame using screwdriver or pry tool; inspect for sealant or adhesive residue; clean and repaint for reuse in similar applications.

technical_features.labels_or_markings: No visible labels; glass appears to be double-glazed with visible spacer bar and desiccant beads.
technical_features.connection_type: glazed into frame with gasket or sealant

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Carefully remove glass unit by releasing gasket or sealant; inspect for cracks or delamination; suitable for reuse in non-load-bearing applications.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify presence of lead-based paint on window frame or sill prior to sanding or removal; test sealant for VOCs or asbestos if building predates 1980.
Inspect glass for laminated safety film or interlayer; if present, handle with care to avoid shattering during removal.
